structure.layout: single-viewport centered splash: animated canvas background, particle-text wordmark, rotating tagline, 4-digit connection code entry, icon nav and credit line

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif (system sans, rendered as DejaVu Sans) everywhere; wordmark is drawn as noisy particle/dither text on a canvas; headline bold with wide letter-spacing; small tracked caption and credit text.
aesthetics.typeScale: Wordmark ~150px canvas; headline 48px/700 letter-spaced two lines; hint 20px tracked; credits 15px/600. Strong contrast between huge display and small tracked captions.

notes: Full-bleed animated fluid/smoke canvas background in deep navy and cyan (WebGL-style), behind a particle-dithered 'ZestSend' wordmark. Headline verb phrase rotates in place with matching icon ('write together' MD icon, 'share a folder', 'listen together' music note, 'share your screen'), while 'with end-to-end encryption' + lock stays in mint green. Core interaction is an OTP-like 4-digit code with underline slots — matching any peer's code connects. Footer is three line icons (globe, gear, info) that open blurred-backdrop dialogs: language list with sample sentence per language, 'Appearance' theme list with tri-color swatches and witty taglines (Midnight Drift, Glacier Blue, Signal Mint, Solar Ember, Rose Circuit, Ultraviolet), and About with diagnostics link. Credit links use a letter-scramble/hover text effect (doubled characters in a11y tree).
